rows.survey.md: | [**Has GPT-6-Astra Achieved Embodied Intelligence?**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22471v1) | 2026 | Manipulation and navigation; 12 benchmarks; 8 real robot configurations with arms, dexterous hands, mobile platforms, and humanoids | Fixed model weights; frozen demonstration-based ICL packages; 1×/10× action budgets; closed-loop review of π0.5 actions | SIMPLE success: 90.8% with ICL vs 70.8% zero-shot (4 common tasks, standard budget); RoboDojo: 54.17% with ICL + closed-loop VLA vs 29.67% with ICL direct control | — |
